title: UI System: notes for Claude
summary: Project guide for Claude: brand-agnostic design system layout, commands, component rules, libraries, and Claude Design canvas/preset conventions with dated owner decisions.
scope: packages/core engine (config, color OKLCH, radius, type, theme, exports, cli)
packages/core styles/ui.css uis-* classes and --uis-* variables
packages/react components (Root, Logo, primitives, nav/front, nav/back, Icon)
apps/playground Next.js 16 static export on GitHub Pages
Claude Design System (UI System · Design System, namespace UIS)
UI System · Canvas pages and boards
Tweaks (Style, Colour, Shape and type, Logo)
Hugeicons, DiceBear Avatar, anime.js v4, React Bits, Untitled UI React, Mobbin, Appllama

decisions.decision: Icons are always Hugeicons free stroke-rounded set via @hugeicons/core-free-icons through ICONS/SOURCE in packages/react/src/Icon.tsx; never hand-drawn paths, emoji or another set, in code or on canvas boards.
Claude Design names: design system 'UI System · Design System', canvas 'UI System · Canvas', archive 'UI System · Retail decisions (archive)'.
Boards are never slim: a new component gets its full sheet.
Per-product sheets (superseded 2026-11-09 by one full design sheet per preset).

Presets are ways of designing, not products: ledger (round), atelier (sharp, was retail-editorial); later mist, signal, studio. Kind (shop, app, website, booking, portfolio) is separate. Three picks: preset, kind, brand on top; product may override anything. Product improvements return as picture-first preset proposals landing on owner's yes.

Canvas pages: Start here / Foundations / Presets / Kinds / Components overview / one page per component family / Patterns / Navigation shells / Use cases / Archive; each family page has one generated board.
Tweaks over copies: never redraw a component per preset, palette, skin or shape; skin Tweak (none + 8 products) fills Root config; default Tweak follows skin and preset, changed one wins.
Every preset gets one full design sheet on Presets page, computed live with UIS.buildTheme, with products using it as skins side by side and a skin Tweak; replaces per-product sheets of 2026-11-08.

Board Tweaks grouped: 1 Style (none, ledger, atelier or a product; mode), 2 Colour (colors style|custom, primary, accent, neutral), 3 Shape and type (shape, type, buttons, density, surface), 4 Logo on nav boards only; every Tweak but Style starts at 'style'.
New visual values go through the engine as --uis-* variables; components never hard-code colors or radii.
Every component works three ways: React props, plain CSS classes, x-import attributes in Claude Design.
Text roles keep 4.5:1 contrast in both themes.
Coverage row checks nine states; a missing state is marked Gap, never drawn as a working control. Superseded boards move to Archive, never deleted.
Avatars via DiceBear (CC0), never stock or invented photos; animation via anime.js v4 respecting config.motion and reduced motion.

notes: Type set by manifest (DOC). Dated owner decisions captured in 'decisions' per orchestrator request; synthesizer may promote them above DOC precedence. Filename hash is a placeholder (nohash00): classifier has no shell to compute SHA-256 of the source path.
